content.text: The only streams this building exposes are `Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor` and heating/cooling setpoints. The F3_Z01 power and CO2 points exist in the graph but have no time series in the catalog. So I cannot corroborate a real load increase, and I have no independent temperature reference (the controller's own thermostat is not in the data, as stated). A monotonically rising reported value is therefore consistent with both local load change and a sensor drift/fault, and the available streams cannot tell them apart.
